subject: CVPR coffee | working w/ MMI, Apella & Moon Surgical
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw Arthrex is hiring CV Engineers (AR registration and SLAM) for
orthopedic perception.

Curious how you're handling ground truth for instrument pose and anatomical
landmarks in arthroscopic video. Specular reflections and fluid distortion
usually break labeling stacks, and mandatory FDA traceability on top makes
it worse.

MMI and Moon Surgical came to us with the same problems.

I'll be at CVPR. Would be great to meet for a coffee and share learnings.

subject: Intro via [SENDER]
text:
Hi [NAME],

[SENDER] suggested I reach out after our call yesterday morning.

He mentioned the labelling team still ironing out quality, specifically
that getting annotators aligned on what they're looking for is causing
variation in the data, and the fix of having them review each other's work
doubles the time.

We work with companies like Veriff on a similar issue. The short version of
how they got around it is that annotators aren't starting from
scratch; they're correcting a first pass which keeps the volume and
accuracy up.

[SENDER] thought you'd have the full picture on whether that's worth
exploring. Does Thursday or Friday morning work for a 20 min call?
